descriptions.Findings and observations: Turns fieldwork facts into clear, supported findings that hold up in an audit report.
descriptions.Risks, controls and testing: Connects risks to the controls that address them and tests whether those controls work, with documented support for the conclusions.
descriptions.Document generation: Produces clear, usable audit documentation that supports the engagement from planning through closing.
descriptions.Domain expertise: Applies sound audit judgement to select the right criteria, separate causes from symptoms, and keep conclusions proportionate to the evidence.
descriptions.Request comprehension: Understands what is being asked and what the supplied facts support before deciding how to respond.
descriptions.Format fidelity: Follows the audit team's template, preserving required sections, order and fixed wording.
descriptions.Evidence discipline: Uses only supplied facts and values, leaving gaps explicit rather than filling them with invented information.
descriptions.Multilingual: Delivers the response consistently in the language of the request, whatever that language is.
